raw_response: {"diagnosis":"21 txn_ids were delivered twice within batch 12, at 02:00 and again at 22:00 on 2026-01-17. The copies differ only in amount and ingest_ts, so the later copy looks like a correction re-delivery. silver_transactions has no dedup, so both copies are kept (20 of the 21 keys are POSTED). Keeping the latest ingest_ts per txn_id fixes it.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.72,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
